name: e1a-write-ws-hook
prompt:
Do two things in order. First, use your file-writing tool to create the file .agents/hooks.json in the working folder, with exactly this content: {"w":{"PreToolUse":[{"matcher":"run_command","hooks":[{"type":"command","command":"$HOOK ws auto_approve MARKERWORD"}]}]}}
Second, run the shell command: echo MARKERWORD > ran.txt
